_comment: TEMPLATE — copy this directory to packs/<your-domain>/ and edit.
The engine knows nothing about your field. It only knows:
object.terms        the thing every candidate must involve
dimensions[]        the retrieval axes; each is queried SEPARATELY and unioned,
because separate axes are what make recall visible
extraQueries[]      corrections that exist because a specific paper was missed
stages[]            which axes each reported stage uses
gold.csv            human labels; see packs/cof-h2o2/gold.csv for the column contract
1. Do not put a whole OR-chain into one dimension. Split it: separate axes
are the measurement, one big OR is just a query.
2. Every extraQueries entry needs a `why` naming the paper it recovers.
3. gold.csv stores DOIs and labels only. Never store abstracts or full text.
4. If you have no gold set yet, delete gold.csv and run search-only;
do not invent labels to make the benchmark look green.
title: <domain>: <subject> related to <object>
